sentences.text: In Re:- An application for bail under Section 439 of the Cod  of Criminal Procedure in connection Bhagwangola P.S. Case  No.291 of 2021 dated 23.06.2021 under Sections 498A/302 of  the Indian Penal Code.

In the matter of : Somir Ali @ Somirul @ Samirul Sk.
 @ Samir Ali.
 ... Petitioner.
 Mr. Tapodip Gupta.
 ...for the Petitione  Mr. S. Datta.
 ...for the State.
 1.
Heard the learned Advocates for the parities.

entities.text:
Somir Ali @ Somirul @ Samirul Sk.
 @ Samir Ali
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: 2. We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is the husband of the victim/housewife.
She suffered homicidal death at the matrimonial home.

Offence, if proved,
would attract mandatory life imprisonment.

3. In view of gravity of the offence and as trial is in progress, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
4.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.
5. Trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same at an early date without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
Signed By : ALOK SETH High Court of Calcutta 15 th of April 2024 05:52:17 PM Somir Ali @ Somirul @ Samirul Sk vs Unknown on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9006338/
